description_en: Queries a DBS backup plan created on the MyBase managed instance page. An empty response indicates that no backup plan has been created for the managed instance
description_zh: 查询在 MyBase 实例纳管页创建的 DBS 备份计划详情，返回为空时说明纳管实例未创建备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun cddc describe-prins-backup-plan --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-name pr-22a21ac289e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePrinsBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The Region ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the self-managed instance
parameters.name: instance_name

BackupPlan.description_en: The details of the backup plan

BackupPeriod.description_en:
The full backup cycle. Valid values:

Monday

Tuesday

Wednesday

Thursday

Friday

Saturday

Sunday



You can select multiple values, separated by commas (,)
BackupPeriod.description_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

支持选择多个取值，用英文逗号（,）分开

BackupPlanCreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the backup plan was created

BackupPlanId.description_en: The ID of the backup plan

BackupPlanName.description_en: The name of the backup plan

BackupPlanStatus.description_en:
The status of the backup plan. Valid values:

wait: Not configured

init: Not started (Pre-check failed)

running: Running

stop: Failed

pause: Paused

locked: Locked

check_pass: Pre-check passed
BackupPlanStatus.description_zh:
备份计划状态，返回值如下：
wait：未配置
init：未启动（预检查失败）
running：运行中
stop：失败
pause：暂停
locked：锁定中
check_pass：预检查通过

BackupStartTime.description_en: The backup start time in HH:mm format

DatabaseType.description_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

MYSQL
DatabaseType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值如下：

MYSQL

EcsInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the ECS instance

InstanceClass.description_en:
The specifications. Valid values:

micro: Micro

small: Small

medium: Medium

large: Large

xlarge: Extra Large (unlimited traffic)
InstanceClass.description_zh:
规格，返回值如下：

micro：入门型
small：低配型
medium：中配型
large：高配型
xlarge：高配型（无流量上限）

UserName.description_en: The name of the database account used for the backup
UserName.description_zh: 备份使用的数据库账号名

OssHint.description_en:
Indicates whether the user has activated OSS.

If this returns false, a backup plan cannot be created successfully. You must activate OSS first
OssHint.description_zh:
用户是否已开通 OSS 服务。
<notice>若返回为 false 则无法正常创建备份计划，需要先开通 OSS 服务。></notice>
